'''M'haeli''' was an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] ruled by a hereditary [[Human/Legends|Human]] monarchy, despite its indigenous [[Species/Legends|species]] being the [[H'drachi]]. Under the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was under the authority of [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Grigor (governor)|Grigor]] and [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Lynch Hauser]]. It was the homeworld of [[Ixidro Legorburu]].

==Description==
An agrarian world located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], the planet was mountainous with vast plains separating the mountain ranges. Large fungus grew in the mountain ranges around falls and waterways. The [[Capital/Legends|capital city]] [[N'croth]] was located on the equator of the world and enjoyed a temperate climate.<ref name="ROC" />

==History==
Discovered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] M'haeli was colonized by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] who pushed the native [[H'drachi]] out of the government and placed them in ghettos across the planet. M'haeli was not involved in the many galactic conflicts which engulfed the galaxy over the centuries, remaining under the control of the Republic since joining the ancient government.<ref name="TEA" />

When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] replaced the Republic at the end of the Clone Wars, the Imperial governance occupied the world and oppressed the H'drachi. In [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], missiles from an unknown offworld attacker destroyed the royal palace on M'haeli, leaving a power vacuum that was filled by the nascent Empire. Although the native H'drachi population resented the occupation, they felt that their mystical abilities granted to them by the "[[time-stream]]" would allow them to ride out the difficult times. The Human population was not as submissive, however, and began an active guerrilla resistance, in league with the wider [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The Rebels deemed M'haeli a strategic refuelling hub between nearby systems. It is unknown whether the Galactic Empire initially attached the same importance to the world, although that changed when it was discovered that it was rich in [[dragite crystal]]s.<ref name="ROC" />

The situation on M'haeli escalated sharply in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] when Grand Moff Lynch sent Lieutenant [[Ranulf Trommer/Legends|Ranulf Trommer]] to investigate the suspicious activities of Governor Grigor. A young woman named [[Mora]], whom Trommer fell in love with, was revealed to be the heir to the M'haeli throne. Trommer defected to the Rebellion and aided [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] in defeating Grigor at the [[Battle of Red Rock]]. Although victorious, the Rebels were then forced offworld by the arrival of Imperial forces under Grand Moff Lynch, leaving M'haeli under occupation and scheduled to be turned into an armaments factory.<ref name="ROC" />
